SELECT s.subject_type AS "subjectType", s.employee_id AS "employeeId", s.customer_id AS "customerId",
        s.token_version AS "tokenVersion", s.expires_at AS "expiresAt", s.revoked_at AS "revokedAt", e.id AS "accountId", e.token_version AS "accountTokenVersion", e.status, e.role, e.username, e.display_name AS "displayName",
          e.must_change_password AS "mustChangePassword", e.permission_version AS "permissionVersion",
          ARRAY(SELECT p.permission_code FROM employee_extra_permission p
            WHERE p.employee_id=e.id ORDER BY p.permission_code) AS "extraPermissions"
      FROM auth_session s LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id=s.employee_id WHERE s.id=$1::uuid
SELECT count(*)::text total FROM inventory_balance WHERE available<=warning_threshold

SELECT b.sku_id AS "skuId",s.code AS "skuCode",p.id AS "productId",p.product_code AS "productCode",p.name AS "productName",
    b.available,b.warning_threshold AS "warningThreshold",s.enabled AS "skuEnabled",(s.retired_at IS NOT NULL) AS "skuRetired",p.status AS "productStatus",(p.archived_at IS NOT NULL) AS "productArchived"
   FROM inventory_balance b JOIN sku s ON s.id=b.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id
   WHERE b.available<=b.warning_threshold ORDER BY b.available ASC,b.sku_id ASC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2

WITH dates AS (
   SELECT generate_series($1::date,$2::date,interval '1 day')::date AS d
  ),p AS (SELECT (paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date d,sum(amount_cents::bigint) n FROM payment
   WHERE status='SUCCEEDED' AND paid_at>=$3 AND paid_at<$4 GROUP BY 1),
  f AS (SELECT (succeeded_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date d,sum(amount_cents::bigint) n FROM refund
   WHERE status='SUCCEEDED' AND succeeded_at>=$5 AND succeeded_at<$6 GROUP BY 1),
  o AS (SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date d,count(*) n FROM "order" WHERE created_at>=$7 AND created_at<$8 GROUP BY 1),
  c AS (SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date d,count(*) n FROM customer WHERE created_at>=$9 AND created_at<$10 GROUP BY 1)
  SELECT dates.d::text date,COALESCE(o.n,0)::text AS "createdOrderCount",COALESCE(c.n,0)::text AS "newCustomerCount",
   COALESCE(p.n,0)::text AS "paidAmountCents",COALESCE(f.n,0)::text AS "refundAmountCents",(COALESCE(p.n,0)-COALESCE(f.n,0))::text AS "netReceiptsCents"
  FROM dates LEFT JOIN p USING(d) LEFT JOIN f USING(d) LEFT JOIN o USING(d) LEFT JOIN c USING(d) ORDER BY dates.d
